name: Silas's Hidden Warehouse
description: A maze of smuggling tunnels and cursed goods beneath the merchant's shop.

hidden_entrance.title: Hidden Staircase
hidden_entrance.description: A narrow staircase descends from Silas's shop into darkness. The walls are lined with shelves of mysterious crates.

main_warehouse.title: Main Warehouse
main_warehouse.description: A vast underground chamber filled with crates, barrels, and mysterious goods. Some items pulse with dark magic. Tunnels lead in multiple directions.

trapped_vault.title: Trapped Vault
trapped_vault.description: A reinforced iron door stands ajar, its lock mechanisms broken. Inside, shelves hold ledgers and documents. A pressure plate trap is visible on the floor.

encounters.description: Poison darts shoot from the walls!

smuggler_tunnel.title: Smuggling Tunnel
smuggler_tunnel.description: A narrow tunnel that connects to the sewer system. Recent footprints show Silas fled this way.

cursed_goods.title: Cursed Goods Storage
cursed_goods.description: Crates marked with serpent symbols contain cursed items and dark artifacts. The air feels thick with malevolent energy.

encounters.description: Cultists guarding the cursed goods attack!

silas_hideout.title: Silas's Final Stand
silas_hideout.description: A small chamber with supplies for flight. Silas stands cornered, a poisoned blade in hand and desperation in his eyes. Maps and documents cover a makeshift desk.

encounters.description: Silas and his bodyguards make their last stand!
